payload.reason: The evidence clearly indicates that among the three pretraining tasks, sentence reordering (SR) is the most effective for improving performance in abstractive document summarization.

claims.text: Sentence reordering (SR) is the most effective pre-training task for abstractive document summarization.
SR consistently achieves the highest ROUGE-2 scores compared to next sentence generation (NSG) and masked document generation (MDG).
Using all three tasks during training generally outperforms using them individually, but SR still shows the best performance overall.
